title: indigo_test: test_aux_skyalert_transport fails, the fake serial port is never used
description: Found on 2026-11-23 while working on ticket b7a94271-41ea-4e5e-b341-5970a0ba7798 and reproduced with master's driver source: test_aux_skyalert_transport fails 0/2. Since commit 48e5adb5d the aux_skyalert driver opens the port with indigo_uni_open_serial_with_speed2(), but the build rule for aux_skyalert_transport.o (indigo_test/Makefile around line 2352) only redirects -Dindigo_uni_open_serial_with_speed=skyalert_test_open, so the fake transport is never used. Proposed fix: redirect indigo_uni_open_serial_with_speed2 and give skyalert_test_open the extra 'const char **error_message' parameter. Check other *_transport tests for the same stale redirect.

outcome.summary: Diff (504434108 vs master) touches only indigo_test/Makefile:2352 (redirect now -Dindigo_uni_open_serial_with_speed2=skyalert_test_open) and indigo_test/integration/test_aux_skyalert_transport.c:32 (fake takes const char **error_message). Root cause confirmed: indigo_drivers/aux_skyalert/indigo_aux_skyalert.c:233 calls indigo_uni_open_serial_with_speed2 and is its only open call; the old redirect did not match. Fake signature indigo_uni_handle *(const char *, int, int, const char **) matches indigo_libs/indigo/indigo_uni_io.h:176 and indigo_uni_io.c:908; compiled without warnings (header prototype is renamed by the same macro, so any mismatch would be a conflicting-types error). The other redirected calls (close, discard, printf, read_section) are all the driver uses. nm on the rebuilt aux_skyalert_transport.o shows only skyalert_test_* undefined, no indigo_uni_* references, so the fake is really used; the test asserts fake-specific record values and opens==closes. Rebuilt the object and test from scratch: test_aux_skyalert_transport 2/2 PASS; test_aux_skyalert_simulator 14/14 PASS (run from indigo_test/). No other changes, no driver change. No findings.

history.text: Reproducing test_aux_skyalert_transport failure before the fix
Running test_aux_skyalert_transport and test_aux_skyalert_simulator after the fix

Reproduction (worktree at 4f07d6d93, before the fix): build/integration/test_aux_skyalert_transport 0/2 (both FAIL; log shows 'Failed to open fake (No such file or directory)' because the driver calls indigo_uni_open_serial_with_speed2(), which the Makefile rule did not redirect, so the real open ran). Fix: indigo_test/Makefile aux_skyalert_transport.o now redirects -Dindigo_uni_open_serial_with_speed2=skyalert_test_open; skyalert_test_open() in integration/test_aux_skyalert_transport.c takes the extra 'const char **error_message' parameter. Driver unchanged. After the fix: test_aux_skyalert_transport 2/2 PASS; test_aux_skyalert_simulator 14/14 PASS; plain flow check (whitespace, unit) passed on tree ba6fa15bb48c.
